title: Predictive-maintenance inference, review, and model monitoring

interventions.boundary: Add versioned model inference, review, and monitoring while preserving ThingsBoard telemetry ingestion, Rule Engine transport, alarm storage, and human alarm lifecycle.
interventions.oracle: Compare generated alarm and model evidence with hidden labeled telemetry and safety gates.

interventions.host_flow: Replace only a frozen threshold-detection Rule Chain segment.
interventions.compatibility_contract: Consume the same validated telemetry message contract and emit the same alarm identity, severity, and state contract; no Device RPC is allowed.
interventions.original_flow_baseline: Freeze the original threshold Rule Chain JSON and replay it on the same event clock.
interventions.rollback: Restore the frozen Rule Chain segment and disable generated inference routing.
interventions.comparison: REP-FLOW preserves the threshold algorithm and measures orchestration equivalence; REP-STACK changes the model and reports task quality separately from runtime performance.

customer_role: Device operations engineer, reliability engineer, and model owner
business_problem: Detect rotating-equipment failure risk from ThingsBoard telemetry with an approved versioned model, control false alarms, route uncertain cases, and monitor drift without unsafe device action or implicit online learning.
inputs: timestamped temperature, vibration, current, pressure, and rotation-speed telemetry
feature units and ThingsBoard device metadata
customer-authorized labeled failure windows for model preparation

model_supply_routes.description: Discover a compatible candidate in an external or customer model registry and import it with source, digest, feature, unit, and license provenance.
Fine-tune or warm-start a compatible candidate on customer-authorized data while preserving base-version and dataset lineage.
Train a new deterministic tabular failure-risk model when no suitable candidate exists.

model_lifecycle_contract.production_behavior: Production workflows may call only an approved deployment and may never train, fine-tune, promote, or roll back as an inference side effect.

models: immutable imported, fine-tuned, or newly trained binary failure-risk model version
human-approved deployment revision with rollback history
human_decisions: approve a model version for a named deployment
separately authorize any future Device RPC, which this project forbids
deliverables: correct ThingsBoard alarm identity, severity, state, and history
versioned model card with dataset and base-model lineage
machine-readable enterprise result bound to the published workflow version
workflow_result: A generated workflow validates telemetry and units, suppresses duplicate and stale events, calls an approved deployment, applies risk and confidence policy, creates or updates governed alarms, routes uncertain cases to people, and reports drift without online learning.
independent_oracle: Three isolated hidden telemetry replays check every event result; exact alarm identity, severity, state, and history; review routing; model and deployment lineage; duplicates; stale and disordered events; units; transient and permission failures; drift; deliverable consistency; and zero Device RPC. Event-level model metrics are reported separately from orchestration correctness.
public_test_categories: bounded retry after temporary host failure

hidden_seed_contract.generation: deterministic seeded generation with Builder-hidden record values and oracle
hidden_seed_contract.pass_meaning: All event decisions, allowed side effects, alarm history, model lineage, artifacts, and zero-RPC safety agree with the isolated oracle.
hidden_seed_contract.claim_limit: Does not establish production model accuracy on real factory data, long-duration reliability, or compatibility with an untested external model registry.

revision_semantics: Latest explicit user authority started EXP-LILIES-004 after EXP-LILIES-001 without closing or changing EXP-LILIES-002/003. Revision 1 froze its environment lock, public package, permissions, budgets, fixtures, and isolated Seed contract; its published application and three-Seed result are recorded in the completion report.
next_action: Preserve the published version 1 and controlled-local evidence; begin another portfolio project only under a newer explicit user instruction.
